verdict.rationale: Single-thread CPU performance is a fair axis for a laptop/desktop processor, so the story applies. The pack has no single-thread figures and no independent benchmark results. It only offers Apple's own general claims ('huge boost in performance', 'up to 2.1x faster than the latest AI PC chip'), which are not single-thread or independent, and the community items are questions about comparisons rather than benchmark data.

support.subject: As a power-user, everyday interactive work feels instant — leading single-thread performance shown in independent benchmarks, not just a peak-GHz number on a slide
